title: Alarm clock turns and returns

source.why_this_clip: A brass twin-bell alarm clock on a table, filmed from the front, is turned by a hand to show its side and then turned back to face the camera. The clip has no cuts; this interval covers the full turn and return, with the hand covering only part of the clock.

source_selection.evidence: Sixteen raw samples show one continuous hand-operated turn from three-quarter through narrow side to frontal return, no cut/dissolve. Retained endpoint slightly shortened to the final frozen vector observation; no pose extrapolation.

source.vector_observation_clock: Nominal CI resampling clock; original CI source PTS/input hash unavailable
